description: Database Architecture Discovery (MANDATORY FIRST): Inspect existing Tutorial PostgreSQL database infrastructure to determine exact connection configuration, Drizzle schema ownership, migration mechanism, table naming conventions, and test database strategy. This establishes repository facts before any implementation.
steps: Inspect packages/db-tutorial/drizzle.config.ts to determine database connection variable (DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL or DATABASE_DIRECT_URL_TUTORIAL), dialect (postgresql), and migration output directory
Examine packages/db-tutorial/src/schema/*.ts to understand existing table naming conventions, schema organization (public schema vs separate schemas), and Drizzle table definition patterns
Review packages/db-tutorial/migrations/ to determine migration file format, versioning strategy, and whether Drizzle owns ALL schema changes for tutorial_prod or if mixed ownership exists
Search for existing Python services using tutorial_prod: grep -r 'DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL' services/ to determine if any other Python service already consumes this database and what patterns they use
Examine packages/db-tutorial/src/db.ts or src/index.ts to understand connection pooling configuration, transaction patterns, and any existing repository/service patterns
Determine test database strategy: search for tutorial_test, test schemas, or Docker-based test databases in existing test files (grep -r 'tutorial.*test' packages/db-tutorial/)
Verify PostgreSQL version and features: examine platform-database-catalog.json or connect to tutorial_prod to check version (PostgreSQL 17.x expected based on catalog)

Document findings in .agents/tasks/task-r3-persistence/r3-database-discovery.md with sections: (1) Connection Configuration (exact env var, connection string format), (2) Schema Ownership (Drizzle exclusive or mixed), (3) Migration Authority (Drizzle-only or allow Alembic), (4) Table Naming Conventions (prefix patterns, snake_case), (5) Test Database Strategy (dedicated DB, test schema, or Docker), (6) Recommendations (how Project AI should integrate)
acceptance_criteria: r3-database-discovery.md exists with complete findings from actual repository inspection
Database connection variable identified (DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL verified in .env.local)
Drizzle schema ownership determined (exclusive or mixed)
Migration strategy recommendation provided (coordinate with Drizzle or use Alembic)
Table naming convention documented (project_ai_ prefix or schema-based)
Test database strategy identified from existing patterns
No assumptions made - all findings based on actual repository files
